dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What do you think about the current crop of actors?

dialogues.speaker: Dorofeya
dialogues.text: I must admit, there is a remarkable wealth of talent among them! If we exclude the veterans like Vodyanitsa entirely... the one who has really caught everyone's eye of late is that Miss Odette. She truly is magnificent.

dialogues.speaker: Akvilina
dialogues.text: As for Violetta... Ah, I once worked alongside her mother. Mind you, while she certainly cannot compare to a preternaturally gifted dancer like Odette...

dialogues.speaker: Akvilina
dialogues.text: When I watch that child dance, I always see... Hmm, how should I put it? Yes, I detect an absolute passion for ballet in every move she makes. That characteristic, coupled with a certain stubbornness that compels her to go all out in every performance, makes her a truly one-of-a-kind performer indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Akvilina
dialogues.text: Everyone is trying their best to dazzle and shine on stage — how wonderful is that?
